name: Member Transactions
query:
SELECT
    lt.library_member AS "Member Name",
    COUNT(lt.name) AS "Total Transactions",
    SUM(CASE WHEN lt.type = 'Issue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Total Issues",
    SUM(CASE WHEN lt.type = 'Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Total Returns"
FROM
    `tabLibrary Transaction` lt
WHERE
    lt.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY
    lt.library_member
ORDER BY
    COUNT(lt.name) DESC
